en.p: In coordinate space there are a right triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$ with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=8$, $\overline{\mathrm{BC}}=6$, $\angle\mathrm{ABC}=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, and a sphere $S$ with diameter $\mathrm{AC}$. Let $O$ be the circle formed where the plane containing line $\mathrm{AB}$ and perpendicular to plane $\mathrm{ABC}$ meets sphere $S$. If $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ are the two distinct points on circle $O$ whose distance to line $\mathrm{AC}$ is $4$, what is the length of segment $\mathrm{PQ}$? [4 points]
